one_line: Verified released PINN checkpoints vs SEM refs and artifact completeness; did not rerun coupled Nektar++ NeuroSEM results.
justification: The replication credibly checks the PINN component: loads shipped .eqx checkpoints with pinned JAX/Equinox, evaluates on large SEM reference grids, and finds monotone-with-Ra error trends and similar magnitudes (within ~2–3×) consistent with SEM potentially reducing error downstream. It also verifies training-point provenance and that key artifacts (checkpoints, SEM refs, PIV data, traced .pt models) exist. However, it does not reproduce the paper’s primary end-to-end coupled NeuroSEM claims (Tables/Figs for u,v,T errors, Nusselt, drag/lift, noisy/missing BC cases, PIV contours) because Nektar++ coupling/patch is not built/run. Thus evidence supports necessary preconditions but not the full reported results.
